forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 29 of July, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Teams completed 3 visits; no zone surveys, technical surveys or clearances were completed. So far, 20 zones have been surveyed and 6 declared free. 18 areas have been released and 8 cleared.

The access feed shows 13 zones closed. No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held, and no new plan was approved; the current plan is P07.

The forecast, made in week 27 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, gives a P10 to P90 range of 11 to 15 mine areas cleared this season and 8 to 10 zones declared free this season.
